2790-3596.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 5.
Angel of Destiny does not have summoning sickness.
2790-3596.notablePrerequisites:
You control three other creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents cannot block flying creatures you control.
2790-3596.description:
Cast Echoing Equation by paying its mana cost targeting Angel of Destiny, causing each other creature you control to become a nonlegendary copy of the targeted creature until end of turn.
Move to combat and declare all your Angels as attackers, sending at least one Angel at each opponent.
When first strike damage is dealt, each Angel of Destiny you control triggers for each creature that dealt damage.
Resolve each trigger, causing each opponent to gain life equal to X times the damage they took (where X is the number of Angels you control) and you to gain life equal to that combined total.
Repeat steps 4-5 for the normal damage step.
At the beginning of your end step, since your life total is at least 45, each Angel of Destiny you control triggers, causing the player it attacked to lose the game.

147-1854-5686.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1854-5686.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, creating a Blood token.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1395-5078-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat

413-2946-4871-4976.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
413-2946-4871-4976.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Open the Graves and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cult Conscript enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

206-2033-3490-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
206-2033-3490-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {G}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

206-222-527-2921.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
206-222-527-2921.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Toralf, God of Fury // Toralf's Hammer

276-1775-2968.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls two or more creatures that can be targeted by spells and abilities you control.
You have a way to deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures such that the excess damage doubled will deal excess damage to the second indestructible creature.
276-1775-2968.description:
Cast Ajani's Presence by paying {2}{W}{W} total, giving two creatures an opponent controls indestructible until end of turn.
Deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures, dealing an increased amount of damage instead due to Angrath's Marauders.
Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the second indestructible creature due to Angrath's Marauders.
Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the first indestructible creature due to Angrath's Marauders.
Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve a Toralf trigger, dealing infinite damage to any target.
276-1775-2968.notes: An example of the pre-requisite: If you give two creatures an opponent controls with toughness 2 and 3 indestructible, you would need to start the loop by dealing 4 noncombat damage to the creature with toughness equal to 2. This will deal 2 excess damage, which will be amplified to 4, thus dealing excess damage to the second creature and continuing the loop. It is recommended to start by giving the two smallest creatures possible indestructible and to target the smaller of the two creatures first.

250-779-1479-3703-6620.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-3703-6620.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Sporemound and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

338-3490-5231-6458.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

You have not cast a spell using The Fourth Doctor this turn If Sensei's Divining Top is on top of your library.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
1170-5078-6709-6979.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, and The Fourth Doctor triggers if you had cast Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking The Fourth Doctor.
Resolve the Fourth Doctor trigger, if applicable, creating a Food token.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

997-1150-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Melira's Keepers
When Melira's Keepers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2239-2792-3647.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
2239-2792-3647.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Ardent Elementalist and Great Whale
When Ardent Elementalist and Great Whale enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
2239-2792-3647.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Great Whale.

3169-3734-6250.description:
Cast Daretti by paying {4}{R}.
When Daretti enters the battlefield, it and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Resolve the Daretti trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Myr to return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Daretti.
Put Phyrexian Metamorph into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Phyrexian Metamorph and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Myr to return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Daretti.
Repeat.

372-813-5895.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Splash Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-813-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Scholar of the Ages and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Scholar of the Ages trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Scholar of the Ages and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

330-1308-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander, and your commander is a Pirate.
You control at least one additional creature or artifact.
330-1308-4508.description:
Activate your commander by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2034-5003-5628.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ajani, adding {C}{C}.
When Ajani dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Ajani from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ajani enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 2/1 Cat Warrior creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Cat Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
When the Cat Warrior dies, Ajani's second ability triggers. Choose not to transform Ajani.
Repeat.

4659-4790-4840.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Myr Battlesphere that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Myr Battlesphere token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing three Myrs, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

560-1245.description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two other creatures, creating a 3/1 Carnivore and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

1047-2011-3053.notablePrerequisites:
Mobile Garrison is a creature.
Mobile Garrison and Prismatic Geoscope do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Mobile Garrison.
You control at least one land of each basic land type.
1047-2011-3053.description:
Declare Mobile Garrison and Najeela, if able, as attackers.
Mobile Garrison triggers, as well as Najeela if it was declared an attacker.
Resolve the Mobile Garrison trigger, untapping Prismatic Geoscope.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, if applicable, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Holding priority, activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2871-3101-3199.manaNeeded: {3}{R}, plus an additional amount of {R} equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin
2871-3101-3199.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
2871-3101-3199.description:
Activate Spellbinding Soprano's encore ability by paying {3}{R} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Declare each Spellbinding Soprano token as an attacker.
Each Spellbinding Soprano token triggers, causing instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn to cost {1} less to cast for each Spellbinding Soprano token.
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate its ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving target creature +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

Glistening Oil attached to Syr Konrad.
You have at least ten creature cards in your graveyard.
386-830-1819.description:
Cast Bone Harvest by paying {2}{B}, putting at least ten creature cards on top of your library from your graveyard.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card that left your graveyard this way, giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

2034-2343-2773-3490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal non-lethal damage to Siegehorn Ceratops.
2034-2343-2773-3490.description:
Deal damage to Siegehorn Ceratops.
Siegehorn Ceratops triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Warstorm Surge.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Warstorm Surge trigger, dealing 1 damage to Siegehorn Ceratops.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-3478-3703.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3478-3703.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Sporemound, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Sporemound trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1020-2034-2478-4986.description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, looking at the top card of a player's library and drawing a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
Myr Retriever triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-3374-4053.notablePrerequisites: You control a white creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
2034-3374-4053.description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving a white creature you control persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the white creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters on it due to Solemnity.
